relation_to_kpp: Supplementary explicit interpretation contract; not an adopted KPP schema or native executable Anchor program.
original_chase_target: A desktop plain-text editor supporting new/open/edit/save/save-as, undo/redo, cut/copy/paste/select-all, find/replace, keyboard shortcuts, and unsaved-change protection.

anchors.responsibility: Receive editor, file, clipboard, selection, search and replacement intents verbatim; no authorization, state change or host effect from capture.
Sole owner of document text, clean baseline, revision and derived dirty status; expose trusted clean-load and save-confirmation hooks invoked only after guarded file actions.

Authorize exact, typed editing, history, file, clipboard and document-bound search/replace commands; reject unbound capabilities, invalid ranges and mismatches; route permitted state changes only to their Neutral owners.
Sole owner of bounded, document-bound undo/redo transitions and its expected revision; use N-DOCUMENT to apply reversals without owning text.

Project Tk document/history/path snapshots; route menu, keyboard, file, clipboard and Find/Replace interactions through BlackHole/WhiteHole; hold only transient visual selection and find dialog input, not document text.

Sole owner of active file path and last confirmed on-disk content digest. Read UTF-8, atomically write UTF-8, detect external conflicts, and coordinate fresh document/history baselines only upon authorized file operations.

Interpret document-codepoint selection ranges and own the explicit, document/history-bound clipboard capability using injected host callbacks. Return selected text / host acknowledgement to WH, without owning document text, undo history, or a parallel clipboard buffer.

Document/history-bound literal search and replace semantics, Unicode codepoint match ranges, case/wrap/direction options, and pure replacement calculations. Own no document text, search result cache or undo history.

Build-time, fail-closed conformance gate for the complete nine-Anchor blueprint: check distinct Anchor identities and roles, source mapping, Neutral state owners, effect boundaries, dependency-ready mandatory obligations, preserved test identities and command allowlist; never dispatch runtime user intents or claim formal KPP satisfaction.

semantics.state: (document.text, document.clean_baseline, document.revision, history.undo_stack, history.redo_stack, history.expected_revision, file_session.active_path, file_session.expected_digest, transient_selection, host_environment)
semantics.index_units: Unicode codepoints, half-open [start,end) ranges. bool is not an integer.
semantics.mutation: Text revision increments once iff text value changes. An effective edit pushes one (before,after) undo entry, clears redo and synchronizes expected_revision; no-op edit leaves undo/redo unchanged.
semantics.history_limit: Configured positive integer (default 100); discard oldest undo transitions beyond limit. The initial history is empty.
semantics.input_ingress: BH-EDITOR-INPUT captures action and payload without authorization, execution, or state changes.
semantics.runtime_guard: WH-COMMAND-GUARD rejects unsupported/invalid actions and authorizes exactly one path. Neutral owners perform approved computation/transitions.
semantics.host_effects: External file and clipboard responses are input observations with explicit success/failure. No logical interpreter may assume a host effect succeeded or actually perform one.
semantics.unknowns: Missing host outcome, unsupported Unicode regex equivalence, unspecified OS semantics, or incomplete initial state => UNDETERMINED rather than success.
semantics.postcondition: After a successful transition, render document snapshot from N-DOCUMENT and any action-specific result. A rejected command leaves document/history untouched, but an external effect might already have occurred.

runtime_effects.description: Read a user-selected absolute UTF-8 file after dirty-discard authorization.
runtime_effects.confirmation: Full read and UTF-8 decode succeed before any document, history or association change.

runtime_effects.description: Write a selected, authorized destination via a sibling temporary file and os.replace; require explicit overwrite grant for unrelated existing targets.
runtime_effects.confirmation: Successful host replacement and unchanged in-memory document revision precede clean-baseline acknowledgement.

runtime_effects.description: Read plain text via the explicitly injected Tk host adapter only for a valid guarded Paste selection. Never read on malformed or unbound requests.
runtime_effects.confirmation: Host callback returns actual plain text, and document/history remain current, before WH replaces text once and records undo.

runtime_effects.description: Write exactly the selected Unicode text via the injected Tk host adapter only for a valid guarded Copy/Cut request.
runtime_effects.confirmation: Host callback returns without error, and document/history remain current, before WH deletes Cut selection and records undo. Copy never changes document/history.

preconditions: captured intent has exact action edit
bound history, if provided, matches current document revision
gate_conditions.transition: Set document.text=payload; if different, revision+=1, record (old,new) on undo stack, truncate to history limit, clear redo; otherwise no state change.
gate_conditions.rejection: CommandRejected; document and history state preserved; no successful transition recorded

preconditions: 0 <= offset <= len(text) measured in Unicode code points
gate_conditions.transition: new=text[:offset]+payload.text+text[offset:]; commit exactly once if changed; record history only on changed text.
gate_conditions.rejection: CommandRejected; document and history state preserved; no successful transition recorded

gate_conditions.transition: new=text[:start]+text[end:]; commit exactly once if changed; record history only on changed text.
gate_conditions.rejection: CommandRejected; document and history state preserved; no successful transition recorded
CommandRejected; document and history state preserved; no successful transition recorded

preconditions: current text equals undo top resulting text
gate_conditions.transition: Set text to undo top previous text, increment document revision once, pop undo to redo, update expected_revision; preserve clean baseline.
gate_conditions.rejection: CommandRejected; document and history state preserved; no successful transition recorded

preconditions: current text equals redo top previous text
gate_conditions.transition: Set text to redo top resulting text, increment document revision once, pop redo to undo, update expected_revision; preserve clean baseline.
gate_conditions.rejection: CommandRejected; document and history state preserved; no successful transition recorded

preconditions: file session and history explicitly bound and current
if dirty, discard must be true
gate_conditions.transition: Set document text to empty and clean baseline to empty; increment revision only if text changed; clear undo/redo and synchronize history; set path and expected disk digest to null.
gate_conditions.rejection: CommandRejected; document and history state preserved; no successful transition recorded

exact_fields.path: absolute nonempty path string with no NUL

preconditions: if dirty, discard must be true
source path is readable; complete read+decode as UTF-8 succeeds before any state change (directory prohibited; symbolic-link source behavior depends on host)
gate_conditions.transition: On successful host read, set document text and clean baseline to decoded UTF-8 text, revision increments if text differs; reset history; associate normalized path and SHA-256 of raw bytes.
gate_conditions.rejection: On read/decode failure, CommandRejected and leave document/history/file association unchanged

preconditions: associated disk content matches expected hash
sibling temp write and replace successfully confirmed by host
gate_conditions.transition: Only after confirmed write: keep document text and revision, set baseline=text and expected disk digest to hash of written UTF-8 bytes; preserve undo/redo history.
gate_conditions.rejection: Any file conflict or write failure is rejected; no confirmed clean baseline is recorded. Disk may have changed independently during non-atomic external events.
notes: After successful disk replacement, document.mark_saved(expected_revision) requires unchanged document revision; a concurrent in-memory change can leave the write complete but baseline acknowledgment unconfirmed.

exact_fields.path: absolute nonempty path string with no NUL

preconditions: if target is current file, expected disk hash must match
gate_conditions.transition: On confirmed write: update active path and expected hash, set clean baseline=text; document revision and history unchanged.
gate_conditions.rejection: When denied or host write fails, preserve document state and association; a failed host effect may have partially touched external filesystem.
notes: After successful disk replacement, document.mark_saved(expected_revision) requires unchanged document revision; a concurrent in-memory change can leave the write complete but baseline acknowledgment unconfirmed.

preconditions: document and history still current after callback
gate_conditions.transition: No document/history changes; clipboard host receives text[start:end].
gate_conditions.rejection: If host clipboard write fails or changes document, reject document edit; clipboard may already have changed

gate_conditions.transition: Clipboard receives selected text first, then delete selected range, increment revision once, record one undo transition; baseline unchanged.
gate_conditions.rejection: On clipboard failure no document edit; external clipboard might change even if stale-callback check rejects

preconditions: host clipboard read returns plain string
gate_conditions.transition: Replace half-open range with host read string; increment revision exactly once if text changes, record one history transition.
gate_conditions.rejection: If host read fails/non-text or binding stale, reject without document mutation

gate_conditions.transition: No document/history/clipboard effect; return [0,len(text)) measured in Unicode codepoints.
gate_conditions.rejection: CommandRejected; document and history state preserved; no successful transition recorded

gate_conditions.transition: Find literal, nonoverlapping regex-escaped query matches; match_case=false uses Python Unicode regex IGNORECASE. Forward chooses first start >= start, backward chooses last end <= start; wrap selects from opposite portion. No state change.
gate_conditions.rejection: CommandRejected; document and history state preserved; no successful transition recorded
notes: Unicode regex equivalence for unusual casefolds depends on specified Python regex profile; if interpreter lacks semantics, report UNDETERMINED, not an invented result

preconditions: selected slice fully matches literal query under specified case semantics
gate_conditions.transition: Replace selected range with replacement; commit one revision iff text changed; record one undo transition iff changed. Report match count=1 even if replacement leaves text unchanged.
gate_conditions.rejection: CommandRejected; document and history state preserved; no successful transition recorded

gate_conditions.transition: Replace all nonoverlapping literal matches (Python Unicode regex case semantics); commit at most one document revision for the entire result; one history transition iff text changed; match count may be positive with no text change.
gate_conditions.rejection: CommandRejected; document and history state preserved; no successful transition recorded
notes: Replacement is literal text, never an interpreted regex replacement template

input_shape.type: GUI event/paint request in Tk host profile

preconditions: GUI event is mapped to one declared editor command and routed through BH then WH
only authoritative document snapshots may be projected as document text
gate_conditions.transition: UI never owns a second authoritative document text. On guarded response, project snapshot and ephemeral selection/find-dialog state; prompting for discard/overwrite occurs in the UI before guarded intent is sent.
gate_conditions.result: Rendered editor text/dirty/path state or an explicitly reported rejected/undetermined UI action.
gate_conditions.rejection: Blocked GUI intent is not silently dispatched to a Neutral state owner.
notes: GUI modality, platform keyboard dispatch and real host paint require actual Tk observations; missing UI event details => UNDETERMINED.

input_shape.type: Candidate source + reviewed spec + manifest + suite/environment

preconditions: Candidate has nine distinct AnchorApplication IDs/types and preserved owner/effect/flow mappings
Required obligation IDs and inherited test identities retained
No admitted candidate without reviewed structural check and full unskipped local test execution
gate_conditions.transition: WH-BLUEPRINT-GATE performs offline read-only conformance evaluation; does not mutate runtime document state or authorize filesystem/clipboard user effects; failure blocks readiness claim.
gate_conditions.result: Structural report plus separate test-run report (valid/invalid, executed/skipped/failed); not a Baker acceptance receipt.
gate_conditions.rejection: When invalid or skipped/failed tests, report candidate not ready; do not claim full preservation.
notes: Source-level checks are not semantic proof and cannot defend against a hostile developer editing the checker and manifest together.

conformance.goal: For known initial state + stimulus + explicit host observations, a separate LLM should derive result and state from these rules alone, or UNDETERMINED.

limitations: This contract is a reviewed design candidate, not a published KPP schema.
No actual LLM ensemble benchmark was run.
Local Python tests provide implementation evidence, not KPP formal Satisfaction or Baker acceptance.
